title: Figure 4: nuclear fission rocket design schematic
description: Cutaway rocket diagram showing a payload nose, a yellow liquid H2 tank, a turbopump, a striped nuclear fuel assembly and a Laval nozzle, each labelled with small callouts. Captioned "Figure 4. Nuclear Fission Rocket Design." The text discusses problems with fission rockets, NERVA tests at the Nevada Test Site, and classical reactor-propelled designs.
